name: My Dear Hatchet Man
source:
Realistically, nothing bad ever happens in the woods, right?
Put all your guards down, and enjoy your time with a friendly stranger, who might have had developed a thing for you!

[From [url=https://gnometastix.itch.io/my-dear-hatchet-man]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
说真的，树林里能发生什么坏事呢，对吧？
放下所有戒心，与一位友善的陌生人共度愉快时光吧。说不定，对方已经对你动心了！

[摘自[url=https://gnometastix.itch.io/my-dear-hatchet-man]Itch.io[/url]]
